tree: Move up or down whenever you need. Your records, history and settings stay exactly where they are — only module access changes.

tree: Is there really no credit card needed for the trial?
Correct. You can create an account, load your products or services and run real transactions for fourteen days before entering payment details.

tree.style: background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(8,18,13,.09); border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px 20px;
font-size: 16.5px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; list-style: none;

tree: No. Business management software is usually sold per tool; Noxtill is sold per plan. A plan unlocks a set of modules and they all share the same data.

tree.style: background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(8,18,13,.09); border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px 20px;
font-size: 16.5px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; list-style: none;

tree: What happens to my data if I cancel?
You keep export access during your notice period and can take everything out in PDF, Excel or CSV. Nothing is held hostage.

tree.style: background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(8,18,13,.09); border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px 20px;
font-size: 16.5px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; list-style: none;

tree: Which currencies can I be billed in?
Your local currency where supported. The checkout shows the exact amount and cycle before you confirm.

tree.style: background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(8,18,13,.09); border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px 20px;
font-size: 16.5px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; list-style: none;

tree: Do I have to use the AI features?
No. Each AI capability can be switched off per branch or per role, and anything AI produces is labelled and approvable before it is sent or published.

tree.style: background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(8,18,13,.09); border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px 20px;
font-size: 16.5px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; list-style: none;

tree: Can we start on Starter and add locations later?
Yes. Adding a second location moves you to Business, and your first location carries over untouched — catalog, customers, staff and history included.
